user.title: IVT Bosch Rego Local Easyconf
user.description: How should the heat pump be found? The search looks on your own network first: an EMS-ESP gateway (BBQKees), then a Husdata H60/H66. Bosch's cloud is offered afterwards, for what the local ways in lack.

found.title: Found on the network
found.description: {count} found. Tick what belongs to this heat pump; one of each kind is ticked already. Values are read from the first in this order that has them: EMS-ESP, Husdata, the cloud.

nothing_found.title: Nothing found locally
nothing_found.description: No EMS-ESP gateway or Husdata interface answered on Home Assistant's network. Log in to Bosch's cloud instead, or enter an address.

manual.title: Address
manual.description: The address of an EMS-ESP gateway or a Husdata interface.

emsesp_auth.title: EMS-ESP login
emsesp_auth.description: To change settings the gateway at {host} needs the login of an admin user of its web interface (by default admin / admin), or an access token from Security → Users. Leave everything empty to read only.

offer_cloud.title: Bosch cloud
offer_cloud.description: The local sources are set. If the pump also has a K30/K40 internet module (IVT Anywhere II), Bosch's cloud can fill in what they lack and stand in while they are away. It needs a SingleKey ID login.

cloud.title: Bosch cloud
cloud.description: Bosch HomeCom is installed and logged in. Borrow its login: no code to paste, and both integrations keep working (Bosch HomeCom renews the login, this one only reads the current one). Or log in on its own.

cloud_code.title: Log in with SingleKey ID
cloud_code.description:
1. Open [this link]({url}) in a new browser tab and log in.
2. After the login the page stays blank or says it cannot open the app. Open the browser's developer tools (F12) → Console and copy the line starting "Failed to launch 'com.bosch...", or the address with `code=` in it.
3. Paste it below within a minute; the code is used once.

cloud_login.title: Bosch cloud
cloud_login.description: Which login page? IVT Anywhere II uses Bosch's.

progress.searching: Searching the local network for an EMS-ESP gateway or a Husdata interface. This takes a few seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered there as EMS-ESP or Husdata.
error.invalid_code: The code was refused. Codes are single use and expire quickly: open the new link and try again.
error.kind_present: This pump already has a source of that kind.

abort.not_supported: Not an EMS-ESP gateway or Husdata interface.
abort.no_gateways: The account has no gateway. Finish pairing the K30/K40 in the app first.
abort.homecom_login_expired: Bosch HomeCom's login has expired. Log in to Bosch HomeCom again, or log in here on its own.
